title: Optimistic Remove
prompt: A React list removes an item immediately while a delete request is in flight. Write a helper that returns a new array without the item whose id matches the id to remove.

explanation.beginner:
Example: optimisticRemove([{"id":"1","label":"A"},{"id":"2","label":"B"}], "1") produces [{"id":"2","label":"B"}]. The result must follow this precise rule: A React list removes an item immediately while a delete request is in flight. Write a helper that returns a new array without the item whose id matches the id to remove. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “keeps items when no id matches”: input [[{"id":"1","label":"A"}],"x"] produces [{"id":"1","label":"A"}]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
